import std.viz

fn main() -> Void {
    axes = linspace(-2.0, 2.0, 17)
    volume = zeros([17, 17, 17])
    for k in 0 until 17 {
        for j in 0 until 17 {
            for i in 0 until 17 {
                x = axes[i]
                y = axes[j]
                z = axes[k]
                r2 = x * x + y * y + z * z
                bump = (x - 0.8) * (x - 0.8) + (y + 0.5) * (y + 0.5) + (z - 0.3) * (z - 0.3)
                volume.set(k, j, i, exp(0.0 - r2 * 0.7) + 0.35 * exp(0.0 - bump * 2.5))
            }
        }
    }
    xy = viz.slice_xy(volume, 8)
    xz = viz.slice_xz(volume, 8)
    yz = viz.slice_yz(volume, 8)
    scene = viz.scene3d("Volume slices")
        .describe("Three orthogonal cuts through a scalar field")
        .labels("x", "y", "z")
        .view(-48.0, 28.0)
        .slice_xy(axes, axes, xy, axes[8], "magma", "scalar value")
        .slice_xz(axes, axes, xz, axes[8], "magma", "scalar value")
        .slice_yz(axes, axes, yz, axes[8], "magma", "scalar value")
    print(scene.svg())
}
